logic: 3.3 V bus direct; fast mode 400 kHz
placement: Full scale is +-8 gauss (0.8 mT): a slider magnet a few millimetres away saturates it. Put it at the far end of the board from the slider magnets, the lid hall magnet, the speaker and the UV-lamp/USB-C steel shells; aim for 25 mm or more from any magnet and check with a real magnet before fixing the position [distance is an estimate].
Not over or under battery nickel tabs, steel screws, shield cans, the microphone cans or high-current traces (charger, converter inductors: keep 10 mm).
Hard-iron offset changes with the slider position: calibrate both states and switch on LID_N. The SET/RESET pulse removes magnetisation after exposure (max 10,000 gauss, p2).
Same side and same axes as the LSM6DSV16X simplifies tilt compensation.
